name: HELLFRONT | Beta
desc:
🛡️ Welcome to HELLFRONT!

It’s a wave-based defense and action game about building, upgrading, and surviving against endless alien swarms.
Adapt your defense, customize your loadout, and fight alongside your machines to protect the military base.
Every wave is harder. Every decision matters. Have fun!

⚠️ [Beta Release]
This game is still under development. New content is actively being added.
If you find bugs or have suggestions, let us know in our community!

❓ [How to Play?]

- Place turrets from your inventory to defend the base
- Kill enemies and mine ores to earn cash and crystals
- Upgrade existing turrets or unlock new ones
- Unlock powerful drones and advanced weapons
- Use pistols, rifles, and explosives to support your defense
- Survive as long as possible against endless waves

🚨 [Coming Soon]

- New Bosses
- New Enemies
- In-Game Events

💻📱 [Platform Support]

- Desktop
- Mobile / Tablets
